meta.title: Texas household resilience context snapshot
meta.scope: Texas statewide and regional educational context
meta.warning: Statewide and historical data do not determine an individual household premium, coverage, claim outcome, or future hazard.

market_snapshot_2025.source: Texas Department of Insurance — Texas homeowners insurance market overview
market_snapshot_2025.notes: TDI labels the 2025 total insured value preliminary. County-level values are available from TDI.

loss_snapshot_2025.source: Texas Department of Insurance — June 22, 2026 transparency announcement
loss_snapshot_2025.notes: TDI states the $8.74B total covers wind and hail; water; fire; and theft, liability, and vandalism for 2025.

rate_filing_context_2026.source: Texas Department of Insurance — market overview
rate_filing_context_2026.notes: Filed rate requests are market aggregates, not a promise that a particular policy will decrease.

flood_planning.source: Texas Water Development Board — 2024 State Flood Plan
flood_planning.notes: The plan combines regional planning and statewide recommendations; local conditions and newer events still require verification.

coastal_wind.harris_note: Parts of Harris County east of Highway 146 in specified coastal cities are also in the catastrophe area described by TDI.
coastal_wind.source: Texas Department of Insurance — market overview / windstorm guidance

nfip_waiting_period.source: National Flood Insurance Program — Buy a Flood Insurance Policy
nfip_waiting_period.notes: NFIP lists exceptions; users should verify timing for their situation. Private flood products can differ.

wildfire.source: Texas A&M Forest Service — Firewise USA / Immediate Noncombustible Zone
wildfire.notes: Texas A&M Forest Service cites IBHS/NFPA research for the 0–5 foot zone and promotes home hardening, evacuation planning, and community coordination.

claims_process_context.source: Texas Department of Insurance — Home insurance guide / claim tips
claims_process_context.notes: TDI describes general claims-processing deadlines, while noting major disasters can alter timelines. Users should rely on current law, policy wording, and TDI guidance for a specific claim.
